data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Thank you for reaching out. The 'User Not Found' error, often seen as AUTH-NF-404.1, typically occurs when an invitation hasn't been accepted or the email is mistyped. Please verify the user's email address in your Admin Console. You can also confirm if the invitation was successfully sent and accepted. If not, resending the invitation should resolve the issue, ensuring they log in with the correct credentials. [T-2060] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
